# Airlock Cycling Notes

Fictional fixture. Exercises how the viewer treats raw HTML: comments are
content the author wrote and can be shown, other markup stays dropped.

<img src="assets/does-not-exist.svg" width="96" alt="Raw HTML tag, never rendered as text">

Above this line sits an `img` tag. It renders as nothing at all, with or
without the comment toggle — a document that opens with a logo tag must not
turn that tag into visible prose.

## Pre-breathe schedule

- Purge the forward lock for 12 minutes <!-- verify-against: procedure 8.4 -->
- Confirm suit pressure at 29.6 kPa
- Log the cycle count <!-- verify-against: procedure 8.7 -->

<!--

  idea the document is annotated at all.

## Post-cycle

The scrubber returns to nominal within two orbits. Nothing else on this page
depends on HTML.
